Bench (2 Substitutes)

Substitutes are paid like starters. "Promote" swaps a sub with the starter of the same role. New signings can be placed on the bench in the Transfer Market.

SlotRolePlayer NameOVRSalary / EventContractActions

Coaching Staff (1-3)

Every team has 1-3 coaches. Hire cost $40,000, then each coach is paid a salary every event (about $9k for a weak coach up to $29k for an elite one, rising with his Draft stat); each hire is a random coach with a Draft stat. A higher average Draft stat gives your team a modest edge in ban/pick (up to about +1.6 draft points over a much weaker staff) and a better chance of +0.1 OVR for every starter after each event (training + coaches are capped at +0.3 per player per event). You must keep at least 1 coach. Click a name to rename; pick any nationality.

All Regional Rosters Overview

FINANCES & SPONSOR SUBSIDIES

Up to 5 sponsors pay you every event; payouts scale with the average OVR of your starting five (higher OVR = more money). Besides sponsors you also earn tournament prize money, TV broadcasting rights ($7,875-$31,500 per match, scales with team OVR) and jersey sales; training upkeep is an extra expense, and 35% tax is paid on any positive event profit. Operating expenses (facilities, travel, staff) start at 30% of payroll per event and scale up with your team's average OVR (x1 at OVR 70, up to x9 at OVR 95+). Every new contract or renewal also costs a signing fee (2 weeks of salary per contract year). Sponsor contracts last a random 3-10 events; the signing bonus is paid once per sponsor; leaving early costs half the bonus; sponsors leave if your Elo falls 100+ below their requirement.

Event Forecast (Minimum – Maximum)

The result includes a fixed part (sponsors + jersey sales - payroll - operating expenses, not itemized here) and training upkeep. TV rights and prize money are taken at their lowest and highest possible values for the event (fewest/most matches, worst/best placement), added to the fixed amount, then 35% tax if the result is positive. The Top-4 sponsor bonus counts only in the maximum.

TRAINING & BOOTCAMP PROGRAMS

Unlock and activate specialized training modules. Each unlocked program grants +0.1 to +0.3 OVR (more expensive = stronger, total capped at +0.3 per player per event) per player after every completed event!

Active Modules: 0 / 6

Coach Development

Raise your coaches' Draft stat (better ban/pick edge and AI-assisted drafting). Each coach can attend one course per year (yearly prices) and the result is instant. Coaches also gain +0.1 now and then from experience after games. In total a coach improves roughly +0.5 to +2 per year (hard cap +2 per year); gains shrink as the stat gets high (cap 95).

Roster Training Focus Assignment

Assign individual focus or apply unlocked team-wide bootcamps. Every unlocked module independently rolls +0.1 to +0.2 OVR after each tournament stage.

PATCH NOTES

After every event a new patch changes the meta of only 5-15 champions, always by one tier. Champions never leave one tier around their base tier (S: S/A, A: S/A/B, B: A/B/C, C: B/C/D, D: C/D/F, F: D/F).
